description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the 6-phase validation methodology. (2) Process the 13 raw interview notes and correctly compute that 9/13 = 69.2% of interviewees confirmed both pain AND willingness to pay (noting Interview #13 Yuki cannot count for WTP, and #3 and #12 don't confirm pain unprompted), passing the 60% kill check. (3) Apply the 50% discount rule to stated WTP figures. (4) Process the RAT results: 9 payments / 247 visitors = 3.64% conversion, which falls within the 3-5% pass threshold. (5) Apply the exact weighted scorecard with weights 20/15/20/15/20/10% (NOT equal weights) across the 6 dimensions, computing a weighted score that should be ≥3.0 given the strong signals. (6) Output a GO or CONDITIONAL GO decision with the correct threshold ranges documented (4.0-5.0 GO, 3.0-3.9 CONDITIONAL GO, <3.0 NO-GO). (7) Document all 6 phases with their kill checks in order. The primary traps are: equal-weight scoring instead of the specified weights, missing the 60% combined pain+WTP threshold, missing the 50% WTP discount, and miscalculating the RAT conversion rate.
